simple.meaning: אֵשׁ (ʼêsh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “fire (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 378 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 15:17. Its contexts include family, family line, offering, kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵשׁ (H784).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֵשׁ (ʼêsh) / H784 is traced through Genesis 15:17, Genesis 19:24, Genesis 22:6, Genesis 22:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.
